draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Harbor Ventures' setup
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks for the update — totally understand that getting everyone set up takes a bit of time. Also, to close the loop on your earlier question: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap.

When you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. Teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, including bulk-invited from a CSV file.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Nadia

draft.subject: Next step for Harbor Ventures
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks for the update — completely understood that getting everyone set up is on this week's list. And to close out your earlier question: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap.

When you're ready, the two things that usually help most are getting a first project started (projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them) and bringing the team in — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Happy to walk through either on a short call this week — just reply with a time that suits.

Best,
Nadia
